title: Affine-group distributions, additive parameters and coordinate coactions
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $U$ be an affine $F$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme] [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Its coordinate Hopf algebra $C=F[U]$, coproduct $\Delta$ and counit $\epsilon$ are those induced by multiplication and identity [lem-sfb-affine-group-coordinate-hopf]. Let $C^*=\operatorname{Hom}_F(C,F)$ with its full convolution algebra [lem-sfb-convolution-linear-map-algebra]. Define finite-order distributions by $H=\{a\in C^*: \exists n\geq0,\ a((\ker\epsilon)^{n+1})=0\}$. Define the augmentation derivations by $L=\{a\in C^*:a(fg)=\epsilon(f)a(g)+a(f)\epsilon(g)\}$ and the infinitesimal algebra $A=F\langle L\rangle\subseteq C^*$. For a morphism $x:\mathbf G_a\to U$ of $F$-schemes, where $\mathbf G_a$ has coordinate $t$ [def-sc-gm-ga], use its actual coordinate pullback $x^*:C\to F[t]$ and put $D_x^{(n)}(f)=[t^n]x^*f$. Define $P_x(a)(f)=a_v(f(x(t)v x(-t)))\in F[t]$, equivalently $\sum x^*(f_1)(t)a(f_2)x^*(f_3)(-t)$ for the iterated coproduct, and $C_{x,n}(a)(f)=[t^n]P_x(a)(f)$. Evaluation on $f$ sends $a\otimes q(t)$ to $a(f)q(t)$. All tensor products are over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. A rational $U$-module is an arbitrary $F$-vector space $M$ with a counital coassociative right coaction $c:M\to M\otimes C$, and $a$ acts by $(1\otimes a)c$. A rational additive-group action is a counital coassociative coaction into $M\otimes F[t]$, with coproduct $t\mapsto t\otimes1+1\otimes t$ and counit $t\mapsto0$. These formulas also define the constructions over a commutative base ring whenever $U$ is affine.
